name: Open Record Assembly
truth: Careful evidence protects people from stories that outrun consent and correction.
shadow: Preservation can become a room so cautious that nothing living is allowed to move.
doctrine: Name the source, preserve the correction, and label the distance.

name: Lantern Theatre Company
truth: Play, image, and story can carry a signal that records alone cannot move.
shadow: A beautiful rendering can forget to show where invention began.
doctrine: Make freely, cite visibly, and keep a route back to the record.

name: Halfway Guild
truth: A signal becomes social when someone crosses part of the distance to meet it.
shadow: Warmth and momentum can still move faster than permission or context.
doctrine: Invite, inspect, carry a return path, and let the pause-holder decide when to continue.
